ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low contrast ratio; approximately 96% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey), with high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) limited to sparse marks and specular highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-field mapping across both lobes. Sparse high-intensity white focal points and thin linear marks (1-3 pixels wide) are distributed across the mid-regions of both lobes. High-intensity textured clusters are mapped to the extreme distal coordinates (tips).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees with a vertical depth-to-width ratio of 1:4 relative to the central fluke region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge shows continuous low-amplitude serration (3-7 pixels) from the notch to the mid-lobes, transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular jagged topography (15-30 pixels) at the distal extremities due to epibiont accumulation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in narrow, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast, multi-tonal (white/brown) pixel groups concentrated at the extreme left and right distal tips, indicating heavy sessile colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, high-contrast white linear streaks; notable diagonal set on the left lobe mid-section and horizontal scratches on the right lobe distal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle (Coronula diadema) colonization at the distal tips of both lobes, creating significant visual rugosity and altering the natural geometric line of the fluke boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: The fluke exhibits a Type 5 pigmentation pattern (near-total black), which is statistically distinct in its lack of large-scale white mottling.
